title: Bakushou!! All Yoshimoto Quiz-ou Ketteisen DX
native_title: 爆笑！！ オール吉本 クイズ王決定戦ＤＸ
overview: Bakushō!! All Yoshimoto Quiz Ou Ketteisen DX is a quiz game based on the popular TV show Yoshimoto Club. There are two different modes. The first mode has the player going on a fantasy quest to rescue a princess and the player has to answer questions correctly to bypass monsters. The second mode is a classic game show in which the player must answer as many questions correctly as possible to get the highest number of points.
